title: Calculus with Analytic Geometry III
intro: Selected saved notes connect three-dimensional coordinates with vector curves, motion and partial derivatives. Each topic contains complete worked examples from the preserved chapter notes.
coverage: Selected worked notes from Sections 12.1, 13.3, 13.4 and 14.3.

chapters.title: Coordinates, planes and displacement vectors
chapters.summary: Measure distance to a coordinate plane and classify a triangle from its displacement vectors.

chapters.title: Arc length and curvature
chapters.summary: Integrate the speed of a space curve and calculate the tangent, normal and curvature of a helix.

chapters.title: Motion and initial conditions
chapters.summary: Differentiate position to obtain motion quantities, then recover position from acceleration and initial data.

chapters.title: First and second partial derivatives
chapters.summary: Differentiate with one input fixed and compare the two orders of mixed differentiation.
